question: Each row of samples has exactly three positive integers. Construct repeated_in_row(samples, r) in Python to return the value occurring at least twice in row r, or 0 if all are different.

The function proper_sum(n) returns the sum of proper divisors of positive integer n. Construct classify_grid(grid) in Python. Return three lists(low, equal, high) containing each grid value whose proper-divisor sum is respectively less than, equal to, or greater than that value. Preserve row-major order and all repeated values. Do not modify grid; call proper_sum for each value.

Construct Shop.sell(self, item) in Python. item has public name and stock. self.request_units() returns the positive requested quantity. Subtract that quantity from item.stock, clamp negative stock to 0, and print name plus "sold out" if stock is 0; otherwise print name, requested quantity and remaining stock.
Construct method pay(self, hours) in class Rental, returning self.ADMIN_FEE for stays of at most5 hours and0 otherwise. Assume hours is a nonnegative integer.
solution:
def pay(self,hours):
    return self.ADMIN_FEE if hours <= 5 else 0
